mainEntity.name: Can this tripod handle heavy professional cameras?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the tripod supports up to 10kg (22lbs), while the geared head accommodates up to 6kg (13.2lbs).

mainEntity.name: Is it suitable for outdoor use?

acceptedAnswer.text: While primarily designed for studio use, the tripod’s aluminium build and detachable monopod make it versatile for outdoor shoots.

mainEntity.name: Does the horizontal centre column affect stability?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the locking mechanism ensures the column remains stable even when fully extended.
Regular cleaning of joints and ensuring all locks are tightened will keep the tripod and head functioning smoothly.

mainEntity.name: What makes a geared head better for product photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: Geared heads allow for precise adjustments on three axes, ensuring perfect alignment for overhead and close-up shots.
